measures.name: Kessler Psychological Distress Scale-6
measures.simple_scoring: sum six complete items; all-the-time=4 to none-of-the-time=0
measures.missing_policy: Rawafid does not calculate a score when any of the six core items is missing because the developer does not prescribe a single missing-value rule.

us_population_reference.meaning: published quick reference for serious mental illness prevalence screening in US population; not a universal or Arabic diagnostic cutoff

arabic_evidence.finding: two-factor K6 solution showed best fit in that sample

measures.name: Kessler Psychological Distress Scale-10
measures.simple_scoring: sum ten complete items; all-the-time=4 to none-of-the-time=0
measures.alternate_scoring_note: Some Australian implementations score responses 1-5, yielding 10-50. Rawafid uses the developer's 0-4 simple scoring and does not mix thresholds across systems.
measures.missing_policy: Rawafid does not calculate a score when any of the ten core items is missing.
